editorDescDefault: Changes to the order or current profile take effect from the next LLM call.
editorDescTerminal: The task has ended; changes only affect future main-agent conversations.
updatedReopened: LLM profiles updated; {count} quota-blocked intents resumed
llmControlAria: View or switch the task LLM profiles
failoverFallback: All selected profiles were judged to be out of quota. Saving the chain resets the failover state.
archiveQueued: Task added to the archive queue
notFound: Task {id} has been deleted, archived, or does not exist

archiveDesc: The task graph, linked records, exclusive assets and traffic, working files and LLM history will be compressed to cold storage. Once archiving completes, you can restore it from the “Archived” page in the task list.
